Config Item Exported Functions

group HAL_CFG_ITEM_EXT_EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS

Functions

uint32_t cfg_get_size(void *p_cfg_payload)

Get the config payload length.

Parameters:

p_cfg_payload -- [in] Set null to get the config module total length on flash OEM Configuration Data. Set a valid RAM address to get the config module total length on the RAM buffer.

Returns:

The total config module length.

void *cfg_backup(uint32_t address, uint32_t backup_len)

Read back the config data on the flash to the ram buffer.

Parameters:

  • address -- [in] Specify the system config read address, default set as OEM Configuration Data.

  • backup_len -- [in] Specify the backup config data length.

Returns:

The config buffer backup pointer on the heap.

bool cfg_write_to_flash(void *p_new_cfg_buf, uint32_t backup_len)

Write the config data on the RAM to the flash.

Parameters:

  • p_new_cfg_buf -- [in] Pointer to the occd config payload data backup on RAM.

  • backup_len -- [in] Specify the config buffer length.

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

The result of config buffer writing operation.

bool cfg_update_item_in_store(uint8_t *p_new_cfg_buf, uint16_t module_id, void *p_cfg_entry)

Update the config entry item in the config data buffer.

Parameters:

  • p_new_cfg_buf -- [in] Pointer to the occd config payload data backup on RAM.

  • module_id -- [in] Specify the config item module id.

  • p_cfg_entry -- [in] Pointer to the config entry item to update.

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

The result of updating the config item in p_new_cfg_buf.

bool cfg_add_item(uint16_t module_id, void *p_cfg_entry)

Update the config entry item on the occd flash.

Parameters:

  • module_id -- [in] Specify the config item module id.

  • p_cfg_entry -- [in] Pointer to the config entry item to update.

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

The result of updating the config item on the flash of system config.

bool cfg_update_mac(uint8_t *p_mac_addr)

Write MAC address to config, this is mainly used on production line.

Parameters:

p_mac_addr -- [in] The buffer hold MAC address (6 bytes).

Return values:

  • true -- Write MAC to config success.

  • false -- Write MAC to config fail.

Returns:

Write MAC to config fail or success.

bool cfg_update_xtal(uint8_t xtal)

Write 40M XTAL calibration data to config sc_xi_40m and sc_xo_40m. This is mainly used on production line.

Parameters:

xtal -- [in] The value of 40M XTAL calibration data.

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

Write calibration data to config fail or success.

bool cfg_update_txpower(TX_POWER_CFG_t *tx_power_cfg)

Write Max Tx Power config data into the system config.

Parameters:

tx_power_cfg -- [in] The pointer to TX_POWER_CFG_t structure data.

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

The result of writing Max Tx Power config data to system config.

bool cfg_update_default_txpower(TX_POWER_CFG_t *tx_power_cfg)

Write Default Tx Power config data into the system config.

Parameters:

tx_power_cfg -- [in] The pointer to TX_POWER_CFG_t structure data.

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

The result of writing Default Tx Power config data to system config.

CFG_SERACH_RESULT_E cfg_read_item(uint16_t module_id, void *p_cfg_entry)

Read the config entry item on the occd flash.

Parameters:

  • module_id -- [in] Specify the config item module id.

  • p_cfg_entry -- [inout] Pointer to the config entry item to read, input the item offset, len and mask, output data.

Returns:

CFG_SERACH_RESULT_E The result of search the config item.

bool cfg_read_mac(uint8_t *p_mac_addr)

Read MAC address.

Parameters:

p_mac_addr -- [out] Specify the buffer to read back the MAC address (6 bytes).

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

Read MAC result.

bool cfg_read_xtal(uint8_t *p_xtal_xi, uint8_t *p_xtal_xo)

Read 40M XTAL XI(sc_xi_40m) and XO(sc_xo_40m) data.

Parameters:

  • p_xtal_xi -- [out] Get the value of 40M XTAL XI calibration data.

  • p_xtal_xo -- [out] Get the value of 40M XTAL XO calibration data.

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

The result of reading 40M XTAL calibration data.

bool cfg_read_txpower(TX_POWER_CFG_t *tx_power_cfg)

Read Max Tx Power config data.

Parameters:

tx_power_cfg -- [out] The pointer to TX_POWER_CFG_t structure data.

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

The result of reading Max Tx Power config data.

bool cfg_read_default_txpower(TX_POWER_CFG_t *tx_power_cfg)

Read Default Tx Power config data.

Parameters:

tx_power_cfg -- [out] The pointer to TX_POWER_CFG_t structure data.

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

The result of reading Default Tx Power config data.

bool cfg_read_le_linknum(uint8_t *master_num, uint8_t *slave_num)

Read LE Master Link Num and LE Slave Link Num form config data.

Parameters:

  • master_num -- [out] Get LE Master Link Num.

  • slave_num -- [out] Get LE Slave Link Num.

Return values:

  • true -- Success.

  • false -- Fail.

Returns:

The result of reading LE Master and Slave Link Num.
